summary: MODERN real-text serve (n=13: 7 tendency + 6 agentive-abstain; VERBATIM MCScript2/UD-EWT, extraction given, solver-adjudicated). On tendency cases the estimator FIRES on 6/7 (coverage 0.857) and is 1.0 accurate where it fires (6 correct) vs lexicon-only 1/7. On DIRECT AGENTIVE manipulation it correctly ABSTAINS 6/6 (rate 1.0) -- the honest behavior (no patient-tendency at stake). Misses are mapped: verb-gate ('blew'/'drain' not gated) + negation ('not very heavy').

rows.sent: A lot of pins were lined up at the end of the lane, and my ball rolled right through the center of them.
rows.note: a ball affords rolling (round); it rolled under its own momentum -> patient tended

rows.sent: I unlocked the bolt on the door, turned the doorknob, and slowly opened the heavy wooden door and then the screen door.
rows.note: a HEAVY door resists opening; opened slowly with effort -> the affector overcame it

rows.sent: I pulled into the lot and parked and saw my friend was already there, sitting on a bench as her son slid down the slide.
rows.note: slid DOWN the slide -> gravity aligned with the outcome -> patient tended

rows.sent: I slid it down in the can and secured the ends tightly around the can to make sure it did n't slip down in the can.
rows.note: slid it DOWN -> gravity aligned -> tended

rows.sent: The coffee table was not very heavy, so I pushed it where the couch had been all by myself.
rows.note: 'not very heavy' -> the table did not resist much, pushed easily alone -> tended (NEGATION: a known gap)

rows.sent: After it warmed up, I lifted the lid and placed the first page of the document inside of the scanner.
I pushed the vacuum all over the floor in every part of the house.
I raised the lid and dropped the bag inside.
I picked up the alarm clock and turned it over, looking at the back and bottom for a place where the batteries go.
I opened the container and dumped the heavy plastic bag.
rows.note: agentive open; 'heavy' modifies the BAG not the container (amod attachment) -> container has no cue

rows.sent: Back in the living room, I tipped the can over each of the plants, offering them water in direct proportion to their sizes.
Ever since he ate up Red Riding Hood's grandma and blew down the houses of two-thirds of the Three Little Pigs, the Big Bad Wolf has held a persistently bad reputation.
rows.note: MISS: 'blew' (blow) is not in the ambiguous-verb GATE -> abstains (verb-gate coverage gap)

rows.sent: First he reached his hand into the full side and pulled out the sink plug, allowing the water to drain.
rows.note: MISS(letting): removing the plug LETS the water drain; 'drain' not gated -> abstains (verb-gate gap)

scope: Small HAND-ADJUDICATED point estimate on MODERN verbatim prose (avoids the McGuffey age confound), extraction GIVEN. Demonstrates the mechanism FIRES on modern inflected text (lemmatization) + reads property adjectives (heavy->resist) + ABSTAINS on agentive manipulation. NOT a benchmark; a real-text accuracy at scale needs auto-extraction + amod-attached adjectives + a 2nd adjudicator + a physical-narrative corpus.
brain_note: Every cue is a Wolff/Talmy force-dynamic input (PINNED). Lemmatization mirrors morphological->lemma lexical access; adjective-reading supplies Wolff's perception/knowledge force input via the linguistic channel.
